title: Tessellate Resource Preview
visibleText:
Feature Sticky Narrative preview
ARCHITECTURE
A shared manifest carries the work forward

Tessellate carries screens, resources, and design choices from composition into Workbench and export.

STEP 01
Choose a product brief

Describe the product and the people it serves in Compose.

STEP 02
Refine the selected project

Compare directions, then adjust structure and Design DNA in Workbench.

STEP 03
Export a standalone project

Download a React/Vite project or a Tessellate manifest for your next steps.
accessibilityScope: Host preview shell only; the isolated preview iframe is inspected separately for content and layout.
